## Description

`opencode` CLI (installed as `opencode-ai`) fails on every invocation, even `opencode --version`.

## Fix

The earlier fix covered ~/.local, ~/.local/share, .local/share and .local/state. It missed ~/.config/opencode/ and /home/sandbox/.config/opencode.
/home/sandbox/.config has mode <mode>. Docker creates it for /home/sandbox/.config/gh in .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml:58.
Add /home/sandbox/.config to the loop in .devcontainer/entrypoint.sh. Keep .devcontainer/entrypoint.sh:21-38 and .devcontainer/entrypoint.sh:45-49 unchanged. Keep .config/gh intact.
